_description: Guards that nothing executes. Every entry names why and the line that removes it. The guard refuses an undeclared unwired guard, and refuses an entry for a guard that has since been wired, so this list only shrinks.

unwired.reason: It is the release-completion gate that scripts/launch-readiness-check.sh runs: it exits 1 while audit/registers/known-flaws.md has an open row or audit/blockers/ has a file, so in CI it would stay red by design until both are empty. It is a release tool, not a merge gate.
unwired.owed: Wire it into the release workflow once audit/registers/known-flaws.md has no open rows and audit/blockers/ is empty.
